source_modifications.change: Uppercut keeps its original target; Exterminate uses four all-enemy hits; card self-HP-loss applies the existing Intangible cap.
source_modifications.reason: Recorded public successors and isolated behavior checks confirm target identity, Exterminate area damage, and HP-loss protection semantics.

source_modifications.change: Per-play Strangle and Oblivion snapshots bind enemy objects rather than mutable list indices. Rage uses unpowered block across manual and automatic play paths, including the previously missing auto-play trigger. Expose HandleEnemyDeaths internally for the host's reviewed potion path.
source_modifications.reason: Creature-removal probes and recorded Rage plus Frail transitions expose index transfer and card-block modifier errors; potion resolution must reuse the existing kill hooks rather than duplicate or omit them.

source_modifications.change: Remove obsolete StrangleBeforePlay state after replacing it with a per-play object snapshot.
source_modifications.reason: The snapshot must not outlive one play or survive by index across enemy roster changes.

source_modifications.change: Remove cloning of the obsolete StrangleBeforePlay list; preserve Skippable, GeneratedUpgraded and GeneratedRetained when cloning pending selections.
source_modifications.reason: Keep clone state consistent with the corrected combat lifecycle and prevent branch copies from changing legal choices or generated-card properties.

integration: Managed net9 host compiles Core with the documented local corrections and unchanged Generated source, without NativeAOT, game DLLs, native exports, Python bindings, or RL packages.
